plugins.description: Per-key model prices, markup/discount and optional exact-name LiteLLM reference import. Actual fallback billing with request price snapshots. Native /v1/models remains global; execution is per-key restricted. No Docker socket or custom image. Linux amd64, glibc >= 2.34; NOT Alpine/musl or ARM64. Tested with CPA v7.2.146. Accounting is estimated; back up state before updates. Read INSTALL.md.
